[{"insert":"Power Conditioning
 
This section escalates effort across five short sets, from a moderate opener to maximal on the last three. This week opens each set with a twenty second bike sprint, then eight devils press and eight box jump overs before you rest out the remainder of the two and a half minutes. Attack the sprint first while you are fresh, then keep moving so you buy back as much rest as you can. Set 1 is moderate, Set 2 is hard, and Sets 3 to 5 are all out.
"}]
